scope: Admin Settings audit-key card through AdvancedAgentCapabilities
current_truth: Source repair is locally green; exact-build native behavior and independent review are unverified. Defect remains open.

diagnosis.boundary: AuditKeyCard asynchronous operation handlers and first-load effect
diagnosis.root_cause: The first-load promise was not caught; export caught to console only; rotation joined the successful mutation and later refresh in one uncaught chain, so a failed refresh obscured a completed key change.
siblings: Initial and retried audit detail reads
diagnosis.repair: Each operation reports a visible result. Details retry performs reads only. Rotation success is recorded immediately after mutation, before refresh. Failed reads clear stale key details. Structured debug logging records only exception type, never error text or key contents.

verification.green: Guarded run audit-key-green-20261003: 3/3 connected-component cases passed without unhandled rejection.
verification.compile: Guarded run audit-key-compile-20261003: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit exited 0.
